releaseNotes: Auto Farm now reads the game's live dig-depth grid and global hay counters, locks onto the replicated needle/key region when its strand position is known, and rotates through 16 fixed upper-edge sectors without repeating one until a full coverage pass is complete. A sector is retired at the real 75% reveal depth, when empty, or after an 8-second safety limit; the in-game status card shows global and local excavation progress.
